topic: What creates the Earth's magnetic field (and why does it move)?
scientific_reframe: How do outer-core convection and rotation sustain the main field, and how can internal dynamics be separated from external currents to explain field motion?
primary_gap: Joint inference of latent core dynamics and external electromagnetic sources remains underdetermined.
recommended_direction: A coupled core-to-space state-space model with synthetic-twin identifiability tests and rolling-origin forecast evaluation.
